name: Claude Code
description: Install Anthropic's Claude Code CLI agent — the terminal-native coding agent that edits files, runs commands, and uses tools autonomously.

version.description: Version of Claude Code to install (npm package version or 'latest')

apiKey.description: Anthropic API key (or set ANTHROPIC_API_KEY env var)

shareConfig.description: When true, symlink ~/.claude to the shared AGENT_CONFIG_DIR so config persists across container rebuilds and is shared with other agents
